derivation: LIFE-007 classifies this as a renewal because the occurrence is PERMITTED with the latest permit, the native request is unchanged and no dispatch consumed it. The latest retained available clock is at the prior permit's exclusive expiry, so eligibility holds. Current authority succeeds and RES-006 removes only this reservation's own unsettled contribution before evaluating the same contribution once, so the registry returns RENEWED. LIFE-008 records the superseded permit, and LIFE-019 leaves both counters unchanged because a renewal is not an initial proposal becoming PERMITTED.
